messages.body:
Good Afternoon Elliot,

I hope you are doing well. I was given your contact information by my twin brother, Andrew Nachman, who recently signed with Guggenheim. I am an Economics and Business student at the University of Texas - Austin, and I'm pursuing a career in banking. I am particularly interested in working for a bulge bracket bank in New York, so I'd really value the chance to have a conversation with you.

If you have any free time in the next week, it would be great to set up a quick phone call. Please let me know if you would be willing to do this. Attached is my resume.

Best,
Jonathan
